statement: ∀ (c : CharP K p) (rho : LR.R p →+* K), letI := c; letI := rho.toAlgebra; ∃ f : LR.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] TensorProduct (LR.R p) K (LR.MR p M), ∀ k m, f (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ k m) = TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) k (LR.embed p M m)
proof:
intro c rho
letI := c
letI := rho.toAlgebra
obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h_T007.1.1.1
let f := (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange ℤ (LR.R p) K K M).symm.trans (e.baseChange (LR.R p) K _ _)
refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
intro k m
have hem : e (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ (1 : LR.R p) m) = LR.embed p M m := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa using he 1 m
simpa [f, hem]
